title: BoardClimb iPhone gym acceptance — not executed
process: Choose the exact wall > explicitly connect > Light up > log > interrupt/recover > verify offline history. Owner/tester: product owner. Run on each manufacturer; record device/firmware and evidence.
reference: Technical setup, preconditions, cleanup and pending evidence: ../iphone-gym-test.md; ADR-0001 requirements. Sign-off belongs to the tester, not the generator.

scenarios.title: GOOD: find, explicitly light and log on Kilter (FR-001/003/005/008/009/012–015)

stages.title: Prepare and choose the correct wall

steps.step: Record app revision, iOS version, board model/layout/size/angle, firmware if visible and test problem names. Get agreement before changing the wall.
steps.expected: The physical wall matches the selected configuration. Tester owns cleanup; use designated test problems, not genuine history.

steps.step: Choose this board layout on Wi-Fi; wait for the first download and open two problems.
steps.expected: Names, published grades, ratings or Not rated, setter and hold map appear. First snapshot may be large; leave app open.

steps.step: Choose the nearby controller and connect.
steps.expected: Only the chosen controller connects; no LED pattern changes. Unknown capabilities remain unknown.

steps.step: With the wall clear, tap Light up once. Compare every lit hold and role with the problem.
steps.expected: Only this explicit tap changes LEDs. Phone says sent from this phone; it does not claim physical confirmation. Record exact mismatches and stop sending if wrong.

steps.step: Browse a different problem, change filters and add one attempt.
steps.expected: The physical LEDs keep the previously sent pattern. Phone logs one attempt immediately.

steps.step: Turn Top on, then off; request Flash after that failed attempt.
steps.expected: Top adds one reversible success attempt and off removes it. Flash after a failed attempt asks for correction or explicit acknowledgement. No passive LED change.

steps.step: Force-close and reopen. Review the recorded problem’s history.
steps.expected: The saved manual attempt and original session day remain. No unsolicited lighting or connection selection on startup.

scenarios.title: BAD: permission denied or Bluetooth off (FR-004/015/016)

steps.step: Turn Bluetooth off or deny BoardClimb Bluetooth access, then look for boards.
steps.expected: An actionable error appears. Browsing downloaded details and logging remain usable. No connection or lighting is claimed.

steps.step: Restore access/radio and explicitly scan and select again.
steps.expected: A controller list is shown; strongest/previous device is never auto-selected. Connect is possible when hardware permits.

scenarios.title: BAD: interruption, wrong layout and competing phone (FR-009–011/017)

steps.step: After sending a problem, lock/unlock the phone, then move out of range and back.
steps.expected: Lost status/recovery is truthful. Reconnect when allowed sends no LED pattern; another Light up tap is required. Record behaviour for each tested manufacturer.

steps.step: While connected, browse a different incompatible configuration and tap Light up.
steps.expected: The command is refused with guidance to use the matching board/layout. It must not send an incomplete or incompatible pattern.

stages.title: Share the wall with a consenting second phone

steps.step: Connect a second consenting phone and issue separate explicit commands, one at a time.
steps.expected: Record simultaneous control, takeover or refusal exactly as observed. Latest successful explicit command wins when supported. Connection alone never changes LEDs. Unknown/refused takeover is not a pass for supported takeover.

steps.step: If an old connection or layout unexpectedly returns, stop sending and note the exact order of taps.
steps.expected: The last explicit selection must remain selected. Report NOK and evidence if an earlier pending connection replaces it.

scenarios.title: IN BETWEEN: offline history and downloaded discovery (FR-004/006/007/014/015/018)

stages.title: Browse without the network or a board

steps.step: After warming the two test problems, turn network and Bluetooth off and reopen the app.
steps.expected: Board/layout choices remain available; downloaded names, grades, ratings and opened hold maps remain readable. History is retained.

steps.step: Open Downloaded; search a cached problem name and apply grade/rating filters.
steps.expected: Results span previously browsed layouts. New unseen layouts need a first download. Missing ratings are not displayed as zero.

steps.step: Add and correct a test attempt while offline, then restart again.
steps.expected: The corrected count persists, never goes below zero and preserves its original date. Top/Flash never inflate attempts.

steps.step: Restore network. Retry catalog loading or refresh; check history.
steps.expected: Refresh preserves cached details/history. New rows remain reachable on further pages after a changed snapshot.

steps.step: Clean up the designated test log entries using visible controls. Return the board to the agreed problem using its official app if necessary.
steps.expected: Tester records which test contributions were removed. Do not uninstall a phone containing genuine history. Only explicit lighting actions change the board.
